pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CrashAnalyzerView/index.tsx:36 The context is presentation only: it reads crash data from a Zustand store and publishes, calls and consumes no tool. A grep over src/components/modules/evaluator for mcp, inputSchema, tools/call and tool_use found nothing. The repo's pof_crash_analyze MCP tool proxies /api/crash-analyzer, a route outside this context's files.

pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/route.ts:45 The pof_asset_generate MCP tool proxies this localhost HTTP route. The handler parses the body straight away, with no origin check and no token (the requireOperator guard used by pipeline-artifacts and visual-gen/chaos-cloth is missing). request.json() also parses a text/plain cross-site POST, so any web page could start paid provider generation jobs.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/route.ts:45 This is the local-port trap: the HTTP listener behind a stdio tool server has no origin validation and no token.
src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/route.ts:173 Long-running generation returns a pollable job handle (202), so the agent's call is never held open.
src/app/api/visual-gen/generate/route.ts:90 The server rejects a bad argument and the error names the accepted values, so the caller can recover in one turn.
